summary: Digital bank (lending, deposits, Galileo tech platform). Q3 2026 revenue +44%, 17.1M members. FY26 guide: ~$840M net income; 2027 guide: ~$6.4B revenue and ~$1.28B net income (20% margin), adjusted EPS ~$0.90.

rationale.roeCurrent: 2027 net income guide ~$1.28B on roughly $10-11B of equity gives ~12%; rises as revenue grows faster than capital.
rationale.roeStable: Mature digital bank with low branch costs earns a little more than the ~11-12% bank average.
rationale.payoutRatio: No dividend; all earnings retained to grow the loan book.
rationale.exitMultiple: 20x year-5 earnings: above banks (~11-13x) for 20%+ growth, below fintech platforms.

thesis.text: SoFi is a profitable, fast-growing digital bank. A bank charter gives it cheap deposits; the opportunity is selling more products (loans, investing, cards) to 17M+ members. Credit quality is the key risk.
bull: Revenue +44% in Q3 2026; 2027 guidance of ~$6.4B revenue and ~$1.28B net income
Cheap deposit funding from the bank charter
Galileo/Technisys tech platform adds fee income
bear: Personal-loan credit losses in a downturn
Valuation already prices in strong growth
watch: Member and product growth each quarter

changes.text: First Claude base case and thesis.
